case.background: Monochromatic light passes through a homogeneous absorbing solution. Determine how transmitted power depends on incident power, solute concentration, and optical path length.
initial_observations: The solution does not fluoresce or scatter within the available range.

instruments.description: A monochromatic source, variable-power attenuator, calibrated solution cell with selectable path length, and transmitted-power detector.
instruments.name: solution_absorption_cell

notes: This is a deterministic idealized benchmark world, not a literal replay of a historical data table.
A valid experiment changes only listed controls and consumes one episode attempt.

FinalSubmission.model must equal 'exponential_attenuation'. FinalSubmission.parameters must contain exactly attenuation_coefficient, path_exponent. Candidate law: I_out = incident_power_uw*exp[-attenuation_coefficient*concentration_mm*(path_length_cm/1 cm)^path_exponent]

readouts.description: Optical power leaving the solution cell.
readouts.name: transmitted_power_uw

case.title: Identify the optical attenuation relation
